extracted.intended_audience: general readers and students of British social and maritime history; historians interested in smuggling and local crime
extracted.subtask_description: A chapter-length historical narrative recounting smuggling incidents, trials, local anecdotes, and epitaphs in Kent and Sussex from the 18th and early 19th centuries, intended as popular-history exposition. Focus is on vivid anecdote, local detail, and primary-source quotations to illustrate social conditions and events.
